key_compatibility: identical key set to CORRECTED-C v1 and to Job 3; inherited from the unconfirmed job2/job3 chain and not re-derived or endorsed here

columns.evaluable_n: sum of the four RECIST cells (CR+PR+SD+PD) for this results group; Job 3's selection rule, reproduced unchanged
columns.arm_set_type_state: NO_ARMS_REGISTERED_IN_THIS_CACHE | ARM_TYPE_ABSENT_IN_THIS_CACHE | PARTIALLY_TYPED_IN_THIS_CACHE | ALL_ARMS_NON_CONTROL_TYPED | ALL_ARMS_CONTROL_TYPED | MIXED_ARM_TYPES
columns.arm_link_state: SOURCE_FIELD_MATCH | LABEL_MATCH | PROPOSED | UNRESOLVED | CONTESTED | UNKNOWN_IN_THIS_CACHE. SOURCE_FIELD_MATCH (v2's SOURCE_CONFIRMED) means only that two agreeing text fields of the SAME cached record, or one unique description field, point at one registered arm. It is a computed source-field agreement, NOT a registry assertion that this results group is that arm, and the two fields are correlated, not independent sources. LABEL_MATCH is a strictly weaker, separate strength and is never summed into it.
columns.arm_link_relation: the exact relation that produced the state; TWO_AGREEING_FIELD_MATCHES:<a>+<b> (v2: TWO_INDEPENDENT_FIELD_IDENTITIES), DESCRIPTION_FIELD_MATCH_ONLY:<a>, LABEL_FIELD_MATCH_ONLY:<a>, LABEL_*_AMBIGUOUS, LEAF_CLAIM_*, CONTRARY_DESCRIPTION_BINDING_CLEARED:<prior relation>, NO_*
columns.arm_link_source_locator: exact field path(s) compared, and for a retained leaf claim the leaf file and line
columns.n_candidate_arms: EXACT number of compatible registered arms; an arm is bound only when this is 1
columns.candidate_arm_indices: pipe-joined armGroups indices, all preserved when ambiguous
columns.bound_arm_index: armGroups index, non-empty ONLY for SOURCE_FIELD_MATCH or LABEL_MATCH. A CONTESTED downgrade CLEARS this field (v2 retained it, violating this schema and its own check); the cleared candidate survives in downgraded_candidate_arm_index.
columns.bound_arm_registered_type_verbatim: armGroups[bound].type verbatim (registration, NOT a clinical role)
columns.downgraded_candidate_arm_index: the armGroups index that WAS bound before a contrary-description downgrade cleared the binding. Empty on every other row. Clearing the binding is not a claim that this candidate is the wrong arm.
columns.contrary_description_locator: exact field path of the registered description that contradicted the binding
columns.contrary_description_evidence_excerpt: that registered description, newline-normalised and cut at 400 characters; a transformed excerpt, not verbatim text
columns.comparator_role: CLINICAL role: COMPARATOR_TYPE_INFERRED_VIA_SOURCE_FIELD_MATCH (v2: COMPARATOR_SUPPORTED_BY_SOURCE_CONFIRMED_ARM_TYPE) | COMPARATOR_PROPOSED_BY_LABEL_FIELD_MATCHED_ARM_TYPE | COMPARATOR_PROPOSED_BY_GROUP_TEXT_{PLACEBO,NO_INTERVENTION,UNSPECIFIED} | CONTESTED | NOT_ESTABLISHED_IN_THIS_CACHE | UNKNOWN_IN_THIS_CACHE. A type INFERRED THROUGH a matched group-arm relationship is not an independently validated clinical comparator; the assumption it rests on is in comparator_role_identity_assumption. NOT_ESTABLISHED means no comparator evidence exists in this cache; it is NEVER a claim that the group had no comparator role.
columns.comparator_role_basis: prose basis naming the fields used
columns.comparator_role_identity_assumption: the unproved group-arm identity assumption a comparator type inferred through a field match rests on; empty when no type was inferred through a relationship
columns.group_text_comparator_wording_unverified: comparator wording FOUND IN THE RESULTS-GROUP TEXT, kept as unverified evidence in its own field whatever the registration says: GROUP_TEXT_PLACEBO_OR_SHAM_WORDING, GROUP_TEXT_NO_INTERVENTION_WORDING, GROUP_TEXT_CONTROL_OR_COMPARATOR_WORDING, GROUP_TITLE_TREATMENT_SEQUENCE_CONTAINING_A_PLACEBO_TOKEN. With zero registered arms this field holds the evidence and the role stays UNKNOWN.
columns.source_join_verification: constant NOT_ESTABLISHED_REGISTRY_JOIN_FIELDS_ABSENT_FROM_THIS_CACHE. The registry's own explicit join fields are absent from this cache, so explicit source-join verification has NOT been established for any row in this table.
columns.registry_type_statement: REGISTRATION statement, distinct from comparator_role: BOUND_ARM_REGISTERED_TYPE_IS_<type> | BOUND_ARM_TYPE_ABSENT_IN_THIS_CACHE | ALL_REGISTERED_ARMS_{NON_,}COMPARATOR_TYPED_CONDITIONAL | ARM_TYPE_ABSENT_IN_THIS_CACHE | ARM_SET_TYPE_NOT_UNIFORM_NO_TYPE_STATEMENT_POSSIBLE | UNKNOWN_NO_ARMS_REGISTERED_IN_THIS_CACHE (v2: NO_ARMS_REGISTERED_IN_THIS_CACHE)
columns.registry_type_statement_assumption: machine-readable assumption the statement rests on, selected from the ACTUAL arm_link_relation (2026-09-08 residual correction) rather than from arm_link_state. Every BOUND row names one of three: ASSUMES_TWO_AGREEING_SOURCE_FIELD_MATCHES_ARE_ARM_IDENTITY_UNPROVED (relation TWO_AGREEING_FIELD_MATCHES), ASSUMES_DESCRIPTION_FIELD_CORRESPONDENCE_IS_ARM_IDENTITY_UNPROVED (relation DESCRIPTION_FIELD_MATCH_ONLY), or ASSUMES_LABEL_FIELD_CORRESPONDENCE_IS_ARM_IDENTITY_UNPROVED (relation LABEL_FIELD_MATCH_ONLY). SOURCE_FIELD_MATCH is reached by two different relations and they do NOT share a premise. A fourth catch-all token names an unclassified relation form and is expected to be unused. In v2 the strongest state left this empty, which read as an independent registry confirmation.
columns.leaf_claim_state: NO_LEAF | LEAF_CLAIMS_NO_ARM | LEAF_LABEL_RESOLVES_UNIQUELY | LEAF_LABEL_NOT_UNIQUE_IN_RECORD | LEAF_LABEL_ABSENT_FROM_RECORD | LEAF_CLAIMS_MULTIPLE_ARMS
columns.leaf_claim_verification_before_downgrade: the leaf verdict that stood before a contrary-description downgrade cleared the binding; preserved, not overwritten
columns.leaf_narrative_transformed_excerpt_not_p: the leaf's free-text evidence field as a TRANSFORMED EXCERPT for human reading (v2 called this 'verbatim', which was false). NO expression in the producer tests it. The untransformed original is reachable only through leaf_claim_locator.
columns.leaf_excerpt_original_chars: length in characters of the untransformed leaf field
columns.leaf_excerpt_at_400_char_cap: YES when the original exceeded the 400-character cut (0 rows observed in this delivery)
columns.sole_arm_multi_results_group_flag: YES when one registered arm faces several results groups
columns.v1_arm_link_state: prior-state index from CORRECTED-C v1, read-only
columns.group_description_transform: the transform applied to that excerpt
columns.group_description_original_chars: length in characters of the untransformed group description

normalisation: case and whitespace only. Punctuation, hyphens, brackets, dosage units and spelling are NOT normalised.
supersedes: CORRECTED-C-arm-attribution-v2-map.tsv (retained unchanged; v3 is a sibling, not an overwrite)
correction: the five finite C2 corrections admitted in C2-Integration2-and-PAB2-root-adjudication-20260908.md: (1) a complement computed as total minus the named state and tested as a partition; (2) a contested binding CLEARED, with its candidate, evidence and locators preserved; (3) zero registered arms decided before any comparator-text branch, with link, registry type statement and comparator role all UNKNOWN and the group wording kept as unverified evidence; (4) the leaf narrative and group description labelled TRANSFORMED EXCERPTS with their transform recorded, and the source-module-absence observation scoped to the ten payload files actually read; (5) machine vocabulary that states the actual strength of the evidence -- SOURCE_FIELD_MATCH and TWO_AGREEING_FIELD_MATCHES, with the unproved identity assumption named on every inferred comparator type. No row was promoted, moved, or re-adjudicated to make any count agree.
